title: Debounce with Cancel and Flush
promptSeed: Implement debounce(fn, wait) returning a function that delays invocation until wait ms after the last call, preserving `this` and arguments. Add .cancel() to drop the pending call and .flush() to invoke it immediately.

title: Throttle with Leading/Trailing Options
promptSeed: Implement throttle(fn, wait, {leading, trailing}) so fn runs at most once per wait window. With trailing enabled, the last call made during a window must fire at the window's end with the latest arguments.

title: Memoize with Custom Key Resolver
promptSeed: Implement memoize(fn, resolver?) caching results by resolver(...args), defaulting to the first argument as the key. Cache falsy results correctly (use has(), not truthiness) and preserve `this`.

title: Function.prototype.bind Polyfill
promptSeed: Implement a bind polyfill supporting partial application of arguments. A bound function invoked with `new` must ignore the bound `this` and keep the prototype chain intact.

title: Deep Clone with Cycles
promptSeed: Implement deepClone(value) handling primitives, arrays, plain objects, Date, Map, and Set. Circular references must be preserved via a WeakMap, not cause infinite recursion.

title: Typed Event Emitter
promptSeed: Build an EventEmitter with on, off, once, and emit. Listeners fire in registration order, removing a listener during emit must not skip others, and the TypeScript version types payloads by event name.

title: Curry and Compose/Pipe
promptSeed: Implement curry(fn) that collects arguments across calls until fn.length is satisfied, then invokes fn. Also implement pipe(...fns) and compose(...fns) for left-to-right and right-to-left composition.

title: Promise.all / allSettled / race Polyfills
promptSeed: Implement Promise.all so results preserve input order, non-promise values are accepted, and the first rejection rejects the result. Then adapt it to allSettled and race, handling an empty iterable correctly.

title: Concurrency-Limited Promise Pool
promptSeed: Implement pool(tasks, limit) running at most `limit` promise-returning tasks at once and resolving results in input order. Start the next task as soon as any slot frees, and reject on first failure.

title: Retry with Exponential Backoff and Abort
promptSeed: Implement retry(fn, {retries, baseDelay, factor, signal}) retrying a failing async fn with exponentially growing delays. Abort via AbortSignal must stop waiting immediately and reject with the abort reason.

title: Fetch with Timeout and In-Flight Deduplication
promptSeed: Wrap fetch so concurrent calls for the same key share one in-flight promise, and each call aborts after a timeout. The shared entry must be removed on settle so later calls refetch.

title: Sequential Async Task Queue
promptSeed: Build a queue where add(task) returns a promise for that task's result and tasks execute strictly one at a time in FIFO order. A failed task must reject only its own promise and not block the queue.

title: Express-Style Middleware Pipeline
promptSeed: Implement a minimal app.use(fn) and handle(req, res) that runs middleware in order via next(), supporting async handlers and error-handling middleware with (err, req, res, next). Calling next() twice must be guarded against.

title: In-Memory Rate Limiter Middleware
promptSeed: Write a middleware limiting each client key to N requests per window using a token bucket or sliding window. Return 429 with a Retry-After header when exceeded, and evict stale entries to avoid memory leaks.

title: LRU Cache with TTL
promptSeed: Implement an LRU cache with O(1) get and set, a max capacity, and optional per-entry TTL. Accessing an entry refreshes its recency, and expired entries are never returned.

title: Flatten Nested Arrays and Objects
promptSeed: Implement flatten(arr, depth) for nested arrays with an optional depth limit, and flattenObject(obj) producing dot-path keys. Handle empty arrays/objects and avoid mutating the input.

title: groupBy / countBy / keyBy with reduce
promptSeed: Implement groupBy(items, keyFnOrProp) returning buckets of items per key, then derive countBy and keyBy. Preserve insertion order within groups and handle the key function receiving index.

title: Array map / filter / reduce Polyfills
promptSeed: Implement Array.prototype.map, filter, and reduce honoring thisArg and callback signature (value, index, array). Reduce without an initial value on an empty array must throw TypeError, and sparse holes are skipped.

title: Safe get / set by Path
promptSeed: Implement get(obj, 'a.b[0].c', default) and set(obj, path, value). Set creates intermediate arrays for numeric segments and objects otherwise, and get returns default only for undefined results.

title: Deep Equality Comparison
promptSeed: Implement deepEqual(a, b) for primitives, arrays, plain objects, Dates, and NaN. Compare key sets rather than just values and handle cycles or explicitly state the assumption.

title: Immutable Sort, Dedupe, and Merge of Records
promptSeed: Given a list of records, return a new array deduped by id (latest wins) and sorted by multiple keys with stable ordering. Input must not be mutated and a comparator must handle strings, numbers, and nulls.

title: useDebounce and useThrottle Hooks
promptSeed: Write useDebounce(value, delay) returning the value only after it has been stable for delay ms. Clear the timer on change and unmount, and avoid stale closures.

title: useFetch with Race-Condition Safety
promptSeed: Build useFetch(url) returning {data, error, loading}, aborting the previous request when url changes or the component unmounts. Never set state from a stale response.

title: Typeahead / Autocomplete Component
promptSeed: Build an autocomplete that debounces input, fetches suggestions, ignores out-of-order responses, and supports arrow-key navigation, Enter to select, and Escape to close. Include basic combobox ARIA roles.

title: usePrevious, useLatest, and useInterval
promptSeed: Implement usePrevious(value) and useInterval(callback, delay) that always calls the latest callback without resetting the timer. Passing a null delay pauses the interval.

title: Infinite Scroll with IntersectionObserver
promptSeed: Build a list that loads the next page when a sentinel element enters the viewport. Prevent duplicate page fetches while loading, stop at the last page, and disconnect the observer on cleanup.

title: Accessible Modal with Portal and Focus Trap
promptSeed: Create a Modal rendered via createPortal that closes on Escape and backdrop click, traps Tab focus inside, and restores focus to the trigger on close. Lock body scroll while open.

title: Todo/Form State with useReducer
promptSeed: Build a todo list with add, toggle, edit, delete, and filter using useReducer with a typed action union. Use stable ids as keys and keep derived data (filtered list, counts) computed rather than stored.

title: Compound Components (Tabs / Accordion)
promptSeed: Implement Tabs, TabList, Tab, and TabPanel sharing state via context, supporting controlled and uncontrolled modes. Add arrow-key roving focus and correct tab/tabpanel ARIA wiring.

title: Two Sum and Hash-Map Lookups
promptSeed: Given an array and target, return indices of two numbers summing to target in O(n) with a single pass. State behavior for duplicates, no solution, and reusing the same element.

title: Balanced Brackets and Stack Parsing
promptSeed: Validate a string of (), [], {} and other characters for correct nesting using a stack. Return early on mismatch and treat leftover open brackets as invalid.

title: DOM / Tree Traversal (BFS, DFS, getElementsByClassName)
promptSeed: Implement DFS and BFS over a tree of nodes with children, then use it to build getElementsByClassName or a path-to-node finder. Provide both recursive and iterative versions and discuss stack depth.

title: Merge Intervals and Sliding Window
promptSeed: Merge overlapping intervals after sorting by start, handling touching intervals and unsorted input. Then solve longest substring without repeating characters using a sliding window in O(n).
